request: 현재 시뮬이 너무 느린 이유 분석 후 해결책 탐색 (2026-09-24)
question: Does the opt-in far-field fine alignment command schedule shorten the paired fine RGB alignment and the whole native mission without losing physical/protocol success?

offline_evidence.scope: 668 recorded moving fine decisions recomputed from original RGB with zero mismatches; commands the schedule would issue. No physical or timing claim.

design.comparison: same runtime source and bundle; only --fine-gain-schedule differs
design.precondition: no other simulation or training process running; record load average before each run

fixed.stage_and_grasp_models: outputs/dispatch-models/e78a5a5777f5bc48/models/{varied,grasp} (faster-dispatch worktree copy; file hashes identical to the v19 simulation-realtime copy used by the replay audit)

command_template: python3 scripts/ugrp_session.py run fine-gain-<run> -- .venv-sim-worker-mac/bin/python -m scripts.sim_cli workflow run dispatch-skills --record outputs/fine-gain-schedule-20260924/<run> --timeout 600 -- --variant open --seed 11 --plan-replay experiments/2026-09-22-parallel-transport/independent-plan.json --contact-profile local_contact_fine --grasp-model-dir <models>/grasp --stage-model-dir <models>/varied --viewer --realtime-control --efficient-capture --auto-route-overlap --overlap-start grasp --max-wall-s 350 [--fine-gain-schedule]
metrics: fine_approach_sim_s (approach_elapsed_sim_s of learned_approach) and per-stage movement slices
whole mission wall_s and control_end_sim_s, motion_sim_to_wall
box pregrasp resource wait SIM s (box now expected to become critical)
issued command count, stage invalid-RGB reobservations, final alignment refinement usage
robot/obstacle contact steps, sampled carried-cargo floor contact, weld steps
acceptance: B runs both reach physical placement/release and protocol completion
No new contact, weld, lease/TTL or permission audit failure
Report B vs A fine alignment SIM s and whole wall time per run; no averaging of aborted runs
Adoption as a default is out of scope for this cohort; a positive result keeps the option experimental
stop_conditions: Any B failure or safety invariant failure stops further B runs for review; A2 still runs for the baseline if budget remains
No budget extension or threshold change inside this cohort
Preserve every run, including failures, with raw paths and hashes
limits: One saved plan, open map, seed 11; not a generalization or real-robot claim
Response constants are a controller calibration from recorded RGB-derived error changes, not a physical measurement
